text: This application proposes to amend the Zoning By-law to permit the development of three residential apartment buildings, consisting of a 14-storey building, two 22-storey towers connected with an eight-storey base building, and a 22-storey tower with an eight-storey base building, and a public park at the southern portion of the site located at 530 The East Mall. A total of 1095 residential units (including 110 replacement rental units) are proposed with 868 vehicular parking spaces and 822 bicycle parking spaces. The development will have a total Gross Floor Area of 84,098 square metres. The Draft Plan of Subdivision application submitted as part of this review proposes to establish three residential blocks, a public park, a storm sewer easement, and road widening blocks.
